name: Aegis
tagline: A walking GPS that routes by safety, using live crime data and street lighting, and reroutes when danger appears.
problem: Pedestrians in high-crime areas fear routine walks home.
solution: Combines real-time police crime data and satellite street-lighting information into a heatmap and safety-optimised routes with alerts and rerouting.
demo_moment: Team-described: plan a walk and watch it avoid an incident hotspot.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best use of Statistics” among 85 submissions.
The team comes from cities where this is a daily concern.
Won the statistics prize: the routing rests on data, not an LLM.

lessons: Fusing two public datasets can carry a project without any AI.
